description:
• Deepawali celebration for 40 children at Jay Santoshi Maa SRA Anganwadi, Ghatkopar. • A joyful initiative by the Inner Wheel Club of Bombay. • Gifts and festive goodies brought smiles to young beneficiaries. • Project sponsored by Ms. Zarin Havewala, with assistance from Ms. Samira
Rambhia. • Project cost Rs. 15,000, benefiting 40 children. Established three years ago, the Anganwadi provides a nurturing space for children from labour-worker families, helping them take their first steps towards learning and a brighter future. Through foundational education,
lessons in personal hygiene, the development of healthy habits and engaging activities, the children are encouraged to learn and grow in a
caring environment.
